description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two different text-to-SQL generation systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four difficulty levels: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis represents the difficulty levels, while the vertical axis indicates the execution accuracy, measured in percentage. For the 'Simple' category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 60.21%, and TA-SQL has a slightly higher accuracy of 63.14%. In the 'Moderate' category, NatSQL's accuracy is 48.60%, while TA-SQL's accuracy is 51.35%. The 'Challenging' category shows NatSQL with an accuracy of 32.32% and TA-SQL with 36.11%. The 'Total' category combines the results from all difficulty levels, with NatSQL achieving an accuracy of 56.19% and TA-SQL slightly higher at 61.19%. The bars are color-coded, with NatSQL represented in a lighter shade and TA-SQL in a darker shade. The chart does not include any additional visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or annotations.
